title: automobile/parts
description: One row per part in the spares catalogue. The parts catalogue a workshop orders from. Not linked to service records in this dataset -- it is a standalone reference table, which makes it a useful small catalogue for testing search and filtering.

oem_code.description: Manufacturer part number in an invented format: two letters for the category and six digits. Does not match any real catalogue numbering.

name.description: What the part is, in plain English, as it would appear on a workshop invoice line.

category.description: Which system the part belongs to, from Brakes and Filters through to Tyres. Useful for testing faceted search.

unit_price.description: Trade price per unit in euros, scaled to the category -- a filter costs a few euros, a turbocharger several hundred.

stock_quantity.description: Units currently held. About 6% of lines are out of stock at zero, which is a case any ordering screen has to handle.
